notes: New: native Pet Bed padlock compatibility using BC’s usual lock controls (client-side; live multiplayer testing required). Removed: Immersive Blindfold Mode. Retained: Color Studio, wardrobe tools, plushies, and 64×64 chat emoticons.

items: Native Pet Bed lock compatibility: enables the built-in PetBed asset’s AllowLock capability on clients using Essentials.
Native Pet Bed Locking status and diagnostic button in Essentials > Settings > General.
SubbysPetBedLockingDiag() console command for troubleshooting asset availability and locking support.
Immersive Blindfold Mode, including its visual overlay, settings, preview, API, and associated background behavior (v3.5.48).
Existing plushie interactions, wardrobe features, Color Studio, mobile essentials, and chat emoticon picker.
22 bundled 64×64 PNG chat icons, including :hari:, :loona: and :subbycat:, and the 12 original SVG reactions with short codes such as :happy: and :love:.
Pet Bed locking uses BC’s normal padlock and permission controls; it adds no custom padlock state or permission bypass.
This feature is a client-side capability patch, not a server-side BC update. Clients without it may not recognize the lock; do not rely on it for security or consent enforcement.
Live-game and multiplayer locking/unlocking behavior has not been verified.
